title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature will provide detailed logging of incoming requests, including errors, to help with debugging and issue resolution. It will also include error handling to prevent crashes and provide meaningful error messages. This will improve the overall reliability and maintainability of the yantraverse framework
testCases: Test error handling with unexpected error
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when all test cases pass and logging is properly configured to handle different scenarios
reason: Improved logging and error handling will enhance the framework's overall quality and usability, making it more attractive to developers and reducing the time spent on debugging and issue resolution
